card.name: Partway through bismuth and benefit-risk terms
card.fires_on: The pole responds to the final piece of a split medical word, mainly "bismuth" (bism|uth) and "risk/benefit" (b|enefit). It also fires on a few other words such as mycophenolate, buccal and gastric or oral before formulation terms.
